notes.title: Patch Note 1.1.0.5
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Time for a new patch ! Here is the changelog: 

1.1.0.5
- English translation totally reworked
- Fix number format in budget increase email
- Sort saved when you go back on prospects page
- Fix injury email when you have a national team
- Fix national team selection bug when choosing only a national team
- Fix satisfaction UI’s init when sending a contract with an exception
- Fix bug on salaries for some specific exceptions
- Players’ satisfaction on contracts improved
- Fix european Leagues not setted as playable
- Fix season achievements when training a national team and a club
- Fix number of games in Australian regular season
- Fix unexpected blocks in fastbreaks

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We just updated the game with a huge patch! Here is the changelog:

Fix issue on tooltips staying opened.
Fix save of season highs at the end of the season
Fix logo’s stretch during draft
Fixed link in the email sent after the draft
Alignment fixed on draft page
More prospects generated in the USA
Fix attendance history
Fix pound sterling currency
Fix coach of the competition history (need to start a new career to see the changes)
Fix filters on search page
Added the possibility to display regularity on search page
Added the possibility to filter by “Regularity” on search page
Fix 6th man role when altering the roster
Added the possibility to pause the match by pressing “P” key.
Adjustments on the rebounds repartition in games
Fix substitutions refreshment after having simulated a quarter
Less buzzer shots made
Less fastbreaks missed
Fix bug allowing to change a player who was shooting free throws.
More injuries when playing a match
Fix career stats and career highs for Belgium (need to start a new career to see the changes)
DataEditor fix career tab for Belgian players
Fix links in season awards emails
Fix number of teams in Italian League 1 (need to start a new career to see the changes)
Fix number of teams in Greek League 1 (need to start a new career to see the changes)
Fix number of teams in Ukrainian League 1 (need to start a new career to see the changes)
Fix league format Croatian league, Belgian League, Serbian League, Polish League, Italian League 2, Spain Women league 1, Women Russian League 1, Chinese League 1, Women Turkish League 1, Swiss League
Fix bug which happened when you’ve modified the budget of your team in the dataeditor
DataEditor fix non closing windows in standalone
Fix some date format when choosing English language
Fix number of points for losses in Italian Leagues
Fix renewal offers for your coach
English translation improved
Display of attendance localized in a game’s summary
Argentinian League added
Sorts saved when you go back on the search page, potential NT players, team players, followed players, competition stats
Fix bug allowing you to hire several times the same staff member
New feature : possibility to stop an observation of a player
Fix junior team’s name when creating a new team
Fix junior recruitment
Improved recruitment of AI teams
Big budgets will recruit more than 9-10 players
Players will more likely accept offer from big teams of “small” championships.
More trades in American league

We hope this answers many of your requests.
Enjoy the game!
